description: Ministry of Industries - Employee Share Holders Association of UL, No. 275 Hapugoda, Kandana
categorisation: This gazette notification involves the Minister of Industries exercising powers under the Societies Ordinance (Chapter 123) to authorize a society's purpose and grant exemptions from specific legal provisions. The content focuses on regulatory matters and legal authority rather than government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes as it deals with statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks.
